Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You shake the prepared bottle and throw it onto the ground. It breaks with a sharp pop, spilling a thick cloud of smoke across the nearby space.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Main Action to throw; one hour per crafting attempt.
Target / range / shape
Up to 3/5/7 connected visible unoccupied ground squares, each within 3 squares.
Duration
Smoke: until the end of your next turn. Crafted supplies remain until used.
Equipment / acquisition
One mixing kit, Bulk 1, if absent. No ingredients or finished smoke granted.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Crafting / Control / Utility

Throw the smoke — Main Action. Use a prepared Smoke Flask supply. Roll Knowledge, then place one connected smoke area with squares joined along their edges. Check the supply’s inventory die after use; its last use still works.

Weak
Fill up to 3 squares.
Standard
Fill up to 5 squares.
Strong
Fill up to 7 squares.

Smoke provides heavy cover across these squares until the end of your next turn. It deals no damage and does not make occupants automatically Hidden.

Make the supply — one hour per attempt. This card permits the Smoke Flask and Travel Food recipes and grants both on learning. Use the recipe’s materials, tools and supply cap. Roll Knowledge: Weak raises one supply by 1 inventory step; Standard by 2; Strong by 3. Check any carried ingredient supply after the attempt. No group crafting.
